name: ExportFlow - Per User Email Outreach Sequences
description: ExportFlow outreach automation using Gemini for per-lead sequences. n8n calls the website API; the website sends and checks replies through each user's connected Google Workspace/Gmail or SMTP account.

parameters.content:
## Required n8n env

EXPORTFLOW_APP_URL=https://exportflow-lovat.vercel.app
N8N_OUTREACH_WEBHOOK_SECRET=same value as frontend
GEMINI_API_KEY=...
GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3-flash-preview
EXPORTFLOW_SEND_BATCH_LIMIT=5
EXPORTFLOW_FOLLOWUP_1_DAYS=3
EXPORTFLOW_FOLLOWUP_2_DAYS=7
EXPORTFLOW_REPLY_CHECK_LIMIT=10

Website/Vercel must also have:
EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
EMAIL_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=https://exportflow-lovat.vercel.app/api/email/google/callback
OUTREACH_TEST_MODE
OUTREACH_TEST_RECIPIENT

Optional shared fallback SMTP/IMAP env can stay configured, but per-user senders are stored from the website Email Sender box.

Do not paste live keys into this JSON.

## 1. Generate per-lead templates

Website calls exportflow-outreach-generate after a campaign draft has leads and business context.

This branch:
- Fetches campaign context from ExportFlow
- Sends it to Gemini
- Saves initial + follow-up templates and per-lead sequences back to the website

The website can then render each lead with a View Template button.

parameters.content:
## 2. Launch campaign

Website calls `exportflow-outreach-launch` after readiness checks pass. ExportFlow queues the initial messages, waits 5 seconds for the queue write to settle, then immediately continues into Send Due Emails so the first outreach does not depend on the schedule trigger.

## 3. Send approved due emails

Runs from three paths: immediately after launch, manual webhook exportflow-outreach-send-due, and a 1-minute backup schedule.

ExportFlow backend sends through the campaign owner's connected email account and uses the approved per-lead sequence already saved on the website. n8n only triggers the backend send route and persists the result.

parameters.jsCode:
const appUrl = String($env.EXPORTFLOW_APP_URL || 'https://exportflow-lovat.vercel.app').replace(/\/+$/, '');
return [{ json: { appUrl, secret: $env.N8N_OUTREACH_WEBHOOK_SECRET || $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '', batch_limit: Number($env.EXPORTFLOW_SEND_BATCH_LIMIT || 5) } }];

nodes.name: ExportFlow API - Get Due Approved Messages

parameters.content:
## 4. Queue follow-ups

Runs on schedule. Backend enforces:
- Follow-up 1 after 3 days from initial sent
- Follow-up 2 after 7 days from initial sent
- Stop if replied, bounced, unsubscribed, failed, held, or manually stopped

## 5. Check replies and stop follow-ups

This branch asks ExportFlow to check recent replies through each campaign owner's connected Gmail/Workspace or SMTP/IMAP account. When a reply references a stored outbound Message-ID, the lead is marked replied and queued follow-ups are skipped.

parameters.jsCode:
const appUrl = String($env.EXPORTFLOW_APP_URL || 'https://exportflow-lovat.vercel.app').replace(/\/+$/, '');
return [{ json: { appUrl, secret: $env.N8N_OUTREACH_WEBHOOK_SECRET || $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '', limit: Number($env.EXPORTFLOW_REPLY_CHECK_LIMIT || 10) } }];

parameters.content:
## 6. Stats rebuild

Keeps dashboard totals fresh: sent, initial, follow-ups, pending approvals, replies, bounces, unsubscribes, failures, and upcoming scheduled emails.

parameters.jsCode:
const appUrl = String($env.EXPORTFLOW_APP_URL || 'https://exportflow-lovat.vercel.app').replace(/\/+$/, '');
return [{ json: { appUrl, secret: $env.N8N_OUTREACH_WEBHOOK_SECRET || $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '', rebuilt_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
